Container.Name: lora-the-explorer
Container.Overview: A location-based exploration RPG played over LoRa mesh radio. Survey hexes, build outposts, and rank up as a Victorian-era cartographic explorer. Requires a MeshCore companion node with WiFi firmware.

Config.Name: Companion Host
Config.Description: IP address of your MeshCore WiFi companion node

Config.Name: Companion Port
Config.Description: TCP port of the companion node (default 4000)

Config.Name: Home Latitude
Config.Description: Latitude of your base camp location

Config.Name: Home Longitude
Config.Description: Longitude of your base camp location

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone name (e.g. America/Phoenix, Europe/London). Sets the clock used for timestamps in radio replies. Game resets (daily survey limit, dispatch) are always UTC and are unaffected.

Config.Name: Database Path
Config.Description: Path to SQLite database inside the container
